# GitHub Invertocat mark

`GitHub_Invertocat_Black.svg` and `GitHub_Invertocat_White.svg` are the
GitHub Invertocat mark (the mark only, no wordmark), taken unmodified
(byte for byte) from the official logo package:

- Source: https://brand.github.com/GitHub_Logos.zip (`GitHub Logos/SVG/`)
- Retrieved: 2026-10-24
- Status: unmodified
- Terms: https://brand.github.com/foundations/logo

The mark is a trademark of GitHub, Inc. It is used only for the
"Report an issue" link that points to GitHub, never as a logo of this
project, and it implies no endorsement. It is served from this package;
the chat loads nothing from outside.
